architecture.credentials: per-process security context with real/effective/saved UID/GID and supplementary groups
architecture.authority_transitions: initial authority is bounded by login identity; exec/profile/identity transitions are monotonic and cannot manufacture capability bits
architecture.memory: strict W^X; anonymous RX requires JIT; shared writable mappings are rechecked against DAC and descriptor access
architecture.filesystem: canonical path engine shared by policy/backend, dirfd-aware openat/mkdirat/unlinkat, Unix owner/group/other DAC, process-effective ownership on creation, sticky /tmp, privileged device policy, sandbox path policy
architecture.sandbox: BrowserBroker/BrowserContent/Untrusted profiles; trusted browser domains retain JIT but lose unrelated authority; untrusted location takes precedence over executable naming
architecture.execution: exec capability + executable bit + world-writable/untrusted path policy for shell and execve
architecture.identity: real setuid/setgid semantics replacing the legacy no-op
architecture.native: IPC transfer capability gate and per-object shared-region size ceiling
architecture.audit: 256-event denial ring plus path-aware [SECURITY-DENY] dmesg records with canonical path and reason
architecture.lifecycle: security state is removed from Process::drop
architecture.dirfd: policy and Linux-compat backend preserve the same directory identity; regular files are rejected as *at bases
